title: DocCloak shared regex rule pack
description: Canonical cross-runtime rule format (architecture doc section 6). One file per region plus universal.json. Patterns are restricted to the ECMAScript/Python common subset; flags live in the flags field (no inline flags); validate is a name resolved against the per-runtime validator registry (validators.ts / validators.py).

pattern.description: Regex source in the ECMAScript/Python common subset (compiled per runtime)

flags.description: Regex flags; the g flag is mandatory, inline flags in the pattern are forbidden

examples.description: Strings that MUST match the compiled pattern (and pass validate, if any); drives the cross-runtime conformance test

validate.description: Name of a post-match validation function in the runtime validator registry

multiline.description: When true the rule runs against the whole document; when false or absent it runs line by line (detectWithRegex splits on newlines, so a match can never span a line break). Only rules whose match legitimately crosses lines (PEM key blocks) set this.
